title: Smart Accounts
description: Manage your smart accounts and their configurations.

emptyState.notConnectedTitle: Connect your wallet to see your Smart Accounts
emptyState.notConnectedDescription: Smart Accounts are created by and belong to your wallet. Connect it to view balances and manage accounts.
emptyState.usdcNotSupported: USDC Smart Accounts are not available yet (MVP).

limit.reachedMessage: You have reached the maximum of {{limit}} Smart Accounts for this business and environment.

labels.track-smart-accounts-information-and-the: Track information and balances of your Smart Accounts.

status.failedRetryable: The deployment failed. You can retry it.
status.failedFinal: The deployment failed and cannot be retried. Delete it and create a new Smart Account.

createModal.title: Create Smart Account
createModal.description: Deploy a new USD8 Smart Account on QDay Chain.

owner.label: Owner
owner.placeholder: Connect your wallet to fill this in

createModal.feeEstimateNote: Creation fee ~3 USD8 (estimate, paid from your wallet).

errors.slugConflict: This name is already in use. Please choose another name.

steps.intro: After you click Create, you'll go through these steps:
steps.running: Creating your Smart Account. Keep this window open.

reserving.title: Reserve the account name
reserving.description: Checked after you enter your Google Authenticator code.

signing.title: Sign in your wallet
signing.description: Approves the account setup. Signing costs no gas.

funding.title: Add USD8 for the gas fee
funding.description: Sends a small amount of USD8 from your existing account to the new one to pay the gas fee. Skipped if the new account already has enough.

submitting.title: Send the request
submitting.description: The system records the deployment and tracks it until the account is active.

createModal.notSponsoredNote: Your first Smart Account is free. This one is not sponsored: its network fee is paid in USD8, so about {{amount}} USD8 is moved from {{source}} into the new account first. What the fee does not use stays in the new account.
createModal.notEnoughUsd8: Not enough USD8 to pay the network fee of a new Smart Account. One of your Smart Accounts needs at least {{amount}} USD8; deposit USD8 into it first.

errors.slugConflict: This name is already in use. Please choose another name.

deleteModal.title: Delete Smart Account
deleteModal.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? The on-chain address stays deployed, but it will no longer be manageable in Portal.

errors.catalogInUse: Cannot delete: this address is still referenced by your catalog payTo.

messages.deployFailed: Deployment failed or was cancelled. Please try again.
messages.walletNotConnected: Connect your wallet before creating a Smart Account.
messages.wrongNetwork: Please switch your wallet to the QDay network before continuing.
messages.deployRequested: Request sent. Your Smart Account is being created — you can track its progress in the table.
messages.retryRequested: Retry requested. The deployment is being sent again.
messages.accountAlreadyDeployed: This address already exists on chain. Please try again; a new address will be used.
messages.noFundingSource: Deposit USD8 into one of your Smart Accounts first; it pays the network fee of a new account.

retry.title: Retry deployment
retry.description: Retry creating "{{name}}"? The system will send the deployment again.

delete.title: Delete Smart Account
delete.description: Delete "{{name}}"? Its deployment failed and cannot be retried, so nothing exists on chain yet.
